name.en: Charge, then choose when to release

summary.zh: 多等一会儿能换强力一击，也可能把安全出手机会等没了。
summary.en: Waiting builds a stronger shot but can cost the safe chance to fire.

rules.zh: 按住攻击进入蓄力状态，松开后发射；蓄力改变伤害、射程或其他效果，并通过音效、光效或进度显示。玩家需要估计敌人的接近速度，在快速弱击与等待强击之间选择。
rules.en: Hold to charge and release to fire. Charge changes damage, range or another effect and is shown through sound or a visible cue. Judge an approaching enemy and choose a quick weak shot or a stronger delayed one.

loop.zh: 根据命中和敌人位置再准备
loop.en: Prepare again from the hit result and new positions

decisions.zh: 弱敌是否值得蓄满，还是快速射击更节省暴露时间？
decisions.en: Does a weak enemy justify a full charge, or is a quick shot safer?

decisions.zh: 快蓄满时目标离开射线，是放弃这次蓄力还是继续追踪？
decisions.en: If the target leaves the firing line near full charge, abandon it or keep tracking?

effect.zh: 前期就有明显收益便于灵活出手；收益集中在末段会鼓励冒险等满。
effect.en: Early gains support flexible releases; back-loaded gains encourage risky full charges.

effect.zh: 减速越多，蓄力越依赖提前选位；完全自由则更强调跟瞄。
effect.en: Greater slowdown makes setup position matter; free movement emphasizes tracking.

implementation.zh: 心之弓的普通攻击可按住蓄力再松开发射，在闪光时机释放还可触发 Power Shot；不同强化会改写该规则。
implementation.en: The Heart-Seeking Bow charges before release and rewards releasing at its flash with a Power Shot; upgrades can alter this behavior.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：提供本作的场景语境，不把静态画面作为本条操作过程的证明。
observation.en: System reference: provides context for this game; the still image does not establish this interaction sequence.

implementation.zh: M1000 Classic 可进行聚焦射击，玩家需要等待聚焦；通常会支付更多单次弹药，换取强化的一发。
implementation.en: The M1000 Classic offers focused shots that require charging and normally spend more ammunition per shot for a stronger hit.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：可见洞穴中的枪械与队友；静图不能验证这里讨论的武器操作及数值。
observation.en: System reference: weapons and teammates are visible in the cave; the still cannot verify the weapon interaction or its values.

cases.rights: Ghost Ship Games / Coffee Stain Publishing

contrast.zh: Hades 的弓加入了精准释放的时间窗口；M1000 的聚焦射击还把弹药投入放进取舍。
contrast.en: Hades adds a precise release window; the M1000 also makes ammunition spent per shot part of the decision.

combination.zh: 组合提案：短射积累失衡，长蓄力消耗失衡条造成击退；玩家要先铺垫，再判断是否有时间完成终结一击。
combination.en: Design proposal: quick shots build stagger while a charged shot consumes it for knockback, asking players to prepare the opening before committing.

setup.zh: 敌人将在两秒后冲到近身，蓄满需要一秒。
setup.en: An enemy will reach melee range in two seconds; full charge takes one.

action.zh: 玩家先蓄满一发，而没有立刻轻射。
action.en: The player commits to a full charge instead of tapping immediately.

result.zh: 强击将敌人击退，重新创造了一段距离。
result.en: The stronger hit pushes the enemy back and creates room.

next.zh: 根据新距离决定再蓄一发，还是转身离开。
next.en: Use the new distance to decide on another charge or a retreat.

firstStep.zh: 先做两档威力、一个接近目标和清楚的蓄满提示。
firstStep.en: Build two power levels, one approaching target and a clear full-charge signal.

pitfall.zh: 如果满蓄力在所有场合都最好，轻射会失去意义。
pitfall.en: If full charge is best in every situation, quick shots cease to matter.

test.zh: 面对慢目标和突然贴近的目标，玩家会不会主动切换蓄力长度？
test.en: Do players vary charge length between slow targets and sudden close threats?
